explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/393: with F_m(N) the number of n ≤ N with f(n) = m, 'Berend and Osgood proved that, for each fixed m, F_m(N) = o(N)'. The Lean statement: for every m the set {n | f n = m} has natural density 0. For m ≥ 1 this is the cited result; for m = 0 the set is the junk set {0, 1}, trivially of density 0, as the docstring notes. Faithful.
